digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria vocabulary and heading standardization
propositions: The Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria headings represent vestigial vocabulary split: all live gate criteria pool and apply a single bar to both, making the SC heading semantically redundant

Success Criteria items written as plain bullets are not counted by _count_ac_items, cannot carry operator-attested tags, and are silently judged by codebase bar rather than individually checkable, creating a tightness gap

Collapse ## Success Criteria into ## Acceptance Criteria across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, author guides, generated documentation, eval specs, test corpus, and 106 live store tickets (converting SC bullets to AC checkboxes)

Three live sites legitimately retain SC vocabulary outside the heading scope: plan_review_T2.md (trial/experiment metrics), plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable definition-of-done wording), and llm/completion.py:288 (heading-sense vocabulary), which must be excluded from the grep validation

Post-migration validation confirms zero SC headings remain across 106 migrated tickets with 8 backticked prose mentions correctly untouched, and regenerated criteria guide contains exactly one SC match (the excluded T2 criterion phrase)
